exposure: inpatient antepartum management strategies for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorder (categorized by prior antepartum admission and predelivery length of stay)
outcome: total hospitalization costs (median and above 90th percentile)
cohort: The study included 3,237 individuals aged 15-54 years who underwent cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) between 23 and 35 weeks of gestation, identified from the 2016-2021 Nationwide Readmissions Database.
finding: Variation in inpatient admission for management of PAS was a significant driver of hospitalization costs, with certain management strategies associated with nearly 3- to 29-times higher likelihood of high total hospitalization costs and $8,907-29,021 adjusted higher median costs.
